_doc: rc9.0-b RMISS VO manifest: AD rc90_mission_vo (27 rows) + rc90b_batch1_vo (25 rows) merged, 52 rows. Files at audio/vo_ai/{ogg,m4a}/rm_*.{ogg,m4a} (RMVO uses the ogg basename + BASE audio/vo_ai/). Radio rows have FX baked: RMVO plays every rm_* clip with SamplePlayer.play(), never radioLine(). AD dry (no-FX) takes are NOT shipped. Aliases (no copy shipped, the target clip plays): rm_o2_ack_1/rm_o3_ack_1/rm_o4_ack_1 -> rm_o1_ack_1, rm_brch_win_1 -> rm_m1_win_1. rm_o1_follow_1 -> vo_ai LT-G04 when vo_ai is loaded, else the pack's rm_o1_follow_1 copy.  rc9.3 wave 1: +39 AD rc93_vo clips (rc9.2 rows; rm_n5a_win_1 reuses rm_n21_win_1). dry/ not shipped. Source /workspace/ad_scratch/rc93_vo/deliver, SHA256SUMS verified. No named-speaker briefing audio.  rc9.3 wave 1 also wires AD rc93_vo2 (35 v1.5 row clips; vo2 wins on id clash). dry/ not shipped. SHA256SUMS verified. Delivered levels kept (no normalize). Radio clips on the radio/special bus, never radioLine(). Night pack staged, not wired.

Doc, wounded go to the pad. If it draws fire, we move.

Golf Six, Two-Six. We couldn't get the wounded out, over.

The bunkers here aren't finished. We help the work party build them.
Three sites. Keep the workers covered, Doc. Treat anyone who gets hit.

Golf Six, Two-Six. First bunker's built. Moving to the next, over.

Golf Six, Two-Six. We couldn't get the LP back in, over.
Two-Six, Six. Change of orders. Bring the LP in. Get to the LZ, over.
Enemy guns on the north bank are shooting at the supply boats.
Ramp drops on the dunes. Clear the bank so boats can pass.
Golf Six, this is Two-Six. Ashore from the amtracs. Moving up, over.
Golf Six, Two-Six. First firing point is clear. Moving on, over.
No air for us. Amtrac guns, you're our support.
Golf Six, Two-Six. Bank is clear. Boats can use the lane, over.
Golf Six, Two-Six. We couldn't clear the bank in time, over.
Two-Six, Six. Change of orders. Fall back off the bank. Get to the LZ, over.
We're digging a fire base on a ridge blasted out of jungle.
If incoming gets too heavy, we lift out and dig in again.
Golf Six, this is Two-Six. On the ridge. Digging in, over.
Golf Six, Two-Six. First position dug. Starting the next one, over.
Two-Six, Six. LZ can't be held. Lift out to the next, over.
Golf Six, Two-Six. Second LZ is dug in. Bird is lifting, over.
Golf Six, Two-Six. We couldn't get the second LZ dug in, over.
We land on our own hill, then attack the next hill north.
Pick your lane up the slope, Doc. Wounded go to our pad.
Golf Six, this is Two-Six. Landed. Moving to the start line, over.

Golf Six, Two-Six. Wounded are at the pad. Bird is lifting, over.
Golf Six, Two-Six. We couldn't take the hill in time, over.
A company's pinned down up the road. We walk in with the tanks.

Golf Six, Two-Six. With the pinned company. Treating wounded, over.

Golf Six, Two-Six. We couldn't get to the company in time, over.

Two-Six, Six. Illumination is on the way. Watch your wire. Out.
Golf Six, Two-Six. Flares going up. Bring the bird in, over.
Noise and light discipline. No talking, no smoking. Eyes on the wire.
Two-Six, Six. Mission complete. Good work out there. Six out.
Golf Six, Two-Six. Wounded aboard. Bird's lifting under fire, over.
Signal flares up! Here they come! Doc, stay close to me!
